promise: Keep scoped evidence and derived facts retrievable beyond one agent session.
audience: People and agents who need inspectable, durable project memory.
trigger: Remember, retrieve, revise or inspect durable project evidence.

modes.name: Remember
modes.output: Verbatim evidence scoped to its project and source.

modes.name: Retrieve
modes.when: A current task needs relevant past evidence.
modes.output: Scoped source-linked results with currency qualified.

modes.name: Maintain
modes.when: A claim changed or retained records need review.
modes.output: Explicit supersession, export or authorized forgetting.

examples.title: Fictional worked example
examples.before: A remembered conclusion is reused as current fact with no source.
examples.after: Scoped evidence and a provenance-linked superseding fact preserve what was known and when.
examples.why: Durable retrieval stays separate from unverified claims of current truth.

boundaries: Portable method installation is independent; native persistence depends on the separate amplifier-data substrate and supported adapters.

verification.expected: Supplied fictional tasks exercise actual mechanisms and failure boundaries.
verification.evidence: 573 native module tests passed, 4 skips; actual native two-consumer and no-host evidence checks also passed. The reviewed code-only Data distribution is public; narrow native evidence acceptance is checked separately.

verification.name: Native host acceptance
verification.expected: Actual provider/host/desktop/daemon/runner acceptance for the selected adapter.
verification.evidence: No live model, real desktop transaction, invitation, deployment or production data migration was performed by this functional baseline.

verification.name: Storage ownership and runtime
verification.expected: Identify the independently released Data foundation and native durability.
verification.evidence: Public amplifier-data 0.2.0 Rust kernel resolves without credentials; original private source/history and all existing stores remain untouched.

publication_status: Installation and evidence scopes are documented below.

marketing.headline: Pick up the evidence, not just the summary.
marketing.lead: Keep scoped source notes, find them in a later session and trace derived facts back to what was actually recorded. Start with a small explicit evidence CLI; add automatic capture only when you need it.

benefits.title: Return to the source
benefits.body: Store verbatim evidence with project scope and provenance so a later answer can cite the record behind it.

benefits.title: Keep changes inspectable
benefits.body: Separate evidence from derived facts and navigation. Supersede a stale fact while retaining the evidence trail.

benefits.title: Start without a model
benefits.body: The explicit native evidence CLI saves and searches local notes without a host, background daemon or embedding model.

walkthrough.title: Keep one useful note
walkthrough.detail: File a fictional parser-check note in a named project and room. Record where it came from rather than saving a conclusion without context.

walkthrough.title: Find it in a later process
walkthrough.detail: Search the same native log for parser. Lexical/BM25 retrieval returns matching evidence and its reference without asking a model to reconstruct the past.

walkthrough.title: Review what changed
walkthrough.detail: Read the source before treating an old claim as current. Derived facts cite evidence; later facts supersede earlier ones without erasing the original record.

use_when: A later session needs the exact project note behind a decision.
You need evidence, derived facts and navigation to stay distinguishable.
You want scoped local records you can inspect and preserve.
not_for: You only need to pass the next task between agents: Project Handoff is a smaller starting point.
You need physical deletion simply by invalidating a fact.
You expect installing a method folder to activate automatic memory or migrate existing stores.
marketing.quickstart_prompt: Use Memory to review this project note. Preserve the exact source, its project scope and the date. Separate observed evidence from any derived claim. Show what needs rechecking before we rely on it today.
marketing.output_preview:
Project: fictional-parser
Evidence: "Parser check remains unverified."
Source: fictional-note

Later retrieval:
  exact source text + content reference
  scoped to this project

Current truth: recheck before relying on it
marketing.example_note: This fictional example shows the evidence trail. The native quickstart lets you test a real local save and fresh-process search with temporary fictional data.
install_notes: The portable skill is guidance. It installs without a database or Memory runtime.
For a working native save/search check, follow docs/NATIVE-QUICKSTART.md. Python 3.11+, Rust and a native compiler are needed for source Data installs.
The reviewed public Data library stays independent. Existing stores are never discovered or migrated by installation.
marketing.proof_summary: The public native path is checked with temporary evidence, two scoped consumers, regeneration and durable restart. Full embedding, host and live-task acceptance remain separate; historical retrieval results keep their original protocol limits.
marketing.next_step: Choose the portable guidance or the native quickstart. Save one fictional note first, then verify you can find the same words in a fresh process.
